acct.pw_hashes_note.src: Passwords are stored as one-way hashes — even our team cannot read them. If you forget it, contact support with your order email.
acct.pw_hashes_note.out: 密码存储为单向哈希值 - 即使我们的团队也无法读取它们。如果您忘记了，请通过您的订单电子邮件联系支持人员。

pw.code_sent_to.src: Sent to {email} — proves it's really you changing the password.
pw.code_sent_to.out: 发送至 {email} — 证明确实是您更改了密码。

pw.updated_note.src: Password updated. You stay signed in on this device.
pw.updated_note.out: 密码已更新。您在此设备上保持登录状态。

acct.phone_hint.src: Used by our team for delivery questions only.
acct.phone_hint.out: 我们的团队仅用于解决交付问题。

acct.email_hint.src: Your email is your login ID and how orders are matched — contact support to change it.
acct.email_hint.out: 您的电子邮件是您的登录 ID 以及订单的匹配方式 - 请联系支持人员进行更改。

acct.wa_hint.src: Get order updates and after-sales support on WhatsApp.
acct.wa_hint.out: 在 WhatsApp 上获取订单更新和售后支持。

acct.pw_change_note.src: Change the password you use to sign in. You stay signed in on this device after changing it.
acct.pw_change_note.out: 更改用于登录的密码。更改后，您在此设备上保持登录状态。

acct.no_addr.src: No address saved yet — add one to prefill it at checkout.
acct.no_addr.out: 尚未保存地址 - 添加一个以在结账时预先填写。
